canonical_name: Incredible Business Networking (IBN) Biz Lunch - West Asheville
summary: IBN is a free, sponsor-funded monthly networking lunch series run by Incredible Towns of WNC, a marketing/advertising agency, held across many WNC towns (this unit is the West Asheville chapter at a Smokey Park Highway buffet). The organizer explicitly advertises it as open to all with no membership, dues, or exclusions, so while some local business owners likely return often, there is no defined roster or membership structure, and the listings themselves only ever describe the rotating pitch of "all are invited to attend and promote their business."

evidence.note: Listings across 11 months use near-identical boilerplate: "All are invited to attend and promote their business, products, and services, and meet new referral contacts" - generic invitation language, no mention of members or a fixed roster.

Organizer is listed as 'Incredible Towns of WNC', a company, not a community group; same organizer runs many differently-branded 'IBN Biz Lunch' events in other WNC towns (Arden, Candler, Woodfin, Hendersonville, etc.), consistent with a company running a recurring promotional format rather than one persistent group of people.

Incredible Towns' own page describes IBN as "no cost to attend and open to all, with no attendance requirements, fees, dues or exclusions" and says there is no defined membership roster, funded instead by business sponsors (Mr. Rooter Plumbing WNC, Big Frog Custom T-Shirts, etc.).

Same page confirms Incredible Towns of WNC operates many such IBN chapters (breakfast clubs, coffee connections, biz lunches) on set recurring schedules across Asheville, Brevard, Hendersonville and other WNC towns - a franchised commercial format, not a single standalone community.

Search results show 'IBN Biz Lunch' events branded separately for Asheville East, Asheville West, Arden, Candler and Woodfin, confirming this is one instance of a repeated multi-location commercial networking product rather than a distinct group with its own identity.
